# CANDIDATE: VIX1D_COMPRESSION_MEANREV_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When VIX1D is low relative to VIX (ratio > 1.5), intraday volatility is suppressed causing SPY to exhibit mean-reversion toward VWAP after deviations. Entry triggers when price deviates >0.3% from VWAP with a bullish reversal candle (close > open, lower wick ≥ 2× body) within first 30 minutes, capturing the long side of this mean-reversion edge. The edge exists because low VIX1D relative to VIX indicates options market underpricing near-term volatility, creating statistical arbitrage opportunities in SPY intraday price action.

## Mechanism

Entry: 
- Calculate VIX/VIX1D ratio using real-time values
- Require ratio > 1.5
- Require SPY price deviation > 0.3% above or below VWAP (using session VWAP)
- Require bullish reversal candle formation (close > open, lower wick ≥ 2× body) within first 30 minutes of trading (09:30-10:00 ET)
- Enter long at next bar open

Exit:
- Primary stop: Chart-stop at opening-range low (ORL) defined as lowest low of first 5-minute bar (09:30-09:35 ET)
- Profit taking: TP1 at 1.0R (risk = entry price - ORL)
- Runner: Trail stop at 15% below high-water mark (HWM) after TP1 fill
- Time stop: 15:50 ET

Regime filter: Only active when VIX < 15 and VIX1D < 10 between 10:00-11:30 EST (mid-morning low news flow window)
